problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit for a specialized courier aircraft to touch down at ten regional airfields, designated as follows:

Airfield Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (83,47)  
Airfield Bravo: Positioned at grid reference (151,20)  
Airfield Charlie: Positioned at grid reference (26,136)  
Airfield Delta: Positioned at grid reference (148,78)  
Airfield Echo: Positioned at grid reference (40,96)  
Airfield Foxtrot: Positioned at grid reference (37,32)  
Airfield Golf: Positioned at grid reference (57,80)  
Airfield Hotel: Positioned at grid reference (130,62)  
Airfield India: Positioned at grid reference (60,193)  
Airfield Juliet: Positioned at grid reference (47,74)

The flight distances between airfields, measured in nautical miles, are precisely defined:
Alpha to Charlie: 105.7 nm  
Alpha to Delta: 72.0 nm  
Alpha to Echo: 65.2 nm  
Alpha to Foxtrot: 48.4 nm  
Alpha to Golf: 42.0 nm  
Alpha to Hotel: 49.3 nm  
Alpha to India: 147.8 nm  
Alpha to Juliet: 45.0 nm  
Bravo to Charlie: 170.5 nm  
Bravo to Delta: 58.1 nm  
Bravo to Echo: 134.5 nm  
Bravo to Foxtrot: 114.6 nm  
Bravo to Golf: 111.5 nm  
Bravo to Hotel: 47.0 nm  
Bravo to India: 195.5 nm  
Bravo to Juliet: 117.2 nm  
Charlie to Delta: 135.1 nm  
Charlie to Echo: 42.4 nm  
Charlie to Foxtrot: 104.6 nm  
Charlie to Golf: 64.0 nm  
Charlie to Hotel: 127.6 nm  
Charlie to India: 66.4 nm  
Charlie to Juliet: 65.5 nm  
Delta to Echo: 109.5 nm  
Delta to Foxtrot: 120.2 nm  
Delta to Golf: 91.0 nm  
Delta to Hotel: 24.1 nm  
Delta to India: 144.8 nm  
Delta to Juliet: 101.1 nm  
Echo to Foxtrot: 64.1 nm  
Echo to Golf: 23.3 nm  
Echo to Hotel: 96.2 nm  
Echo to India: 99.0 nm  
Echo to Juliet: 23.1 nm  
Foxtrot to Golf: 52.0 nm  
Foxtrot to Hotel: 97.7 nm  
Foxtrot to India: 162.6 nm  
Foxtrot to Juliet: 43.2 nm  
Golf to Hotel: 75.2 nm  
Golf to India: 113.0 nm  
Golf to Juliet: 11.7 nm  
Hotel to India: 148.5 nm  
Hotel to Juliet: 83.9 nm  
India to Juliet: 119.7 nm

Due to airspace restrictions, a direct flight corridor between Airfield Alpha and Airfield Bravo is permanently unavailable. Furthermore, due to a scheduling and routing mandate, the flight plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two specific corridors: the corridor between Bravo and Charlie, or the corridor between Charlie and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal-distance closed-loop flight itinerary that visits every airfield precisely once and concludes at the point of origin.
